definitions.B_MAIN_ORIGINAL: Original base5 + MAIN task branch + PTC fill
definitions.POOL_ONLY_PTC: base5 + top PTC of union all 49 curated links + PTC fill
definitions.SELECTED_CARD_PTC: base5 + selected MAIN cards per-view top5 by PTC + PTC fill
definitions.RANDOM_CARD_PTC: mean of all choose(4,main_card_count) PTC view selections

limitations: Existing 20 synthetic questions reused; no sealed independent test
Same model family selected roles and judged full-112 relevance
Pool-only and original B use different scoring/selection, so B-vs-pool is not pure causal view effect
Random-vs-selected controls curated links, PTC scoring, same number of cards and U; does not exactly reproduce original B task scoring
No new human grading of ablated control candidates; no new case-source audit
